entries.source:
\sysS[89]The \c[52]Dream Vault\c[0] is a place where you 
overcome the barriers of space and
time to transfer items.
entries.translation:
\sysS[89]\c[52]梦幻仓库\c[0]可以跨越时空阻隔，
用于转移物品。

japanese_check.text:

アイテムを受け渡しできる倉庫です。

most recent instance of its use.
entries.translation:
\sysS[89]梦幻仓库只会保存
最近一次使用时的状态。

\sysS[89]If you go back to a saved adventure 
that you already received the rating results for, 
you \c[52]will not be able to use the Dream Vault\c[0].
entries.translation:
\sysS[89]若返回已经领取评价结果的存档冒险，
你将\c[52]无法使用梦幻仓库\c[0]。

\sysS[89]如果你回到一个拯救的冒险 
已经收到了评分结果 
你个混蛋 \c[52]将无法使用梦之洞\c[0].

// Updated Keyboard 
[KB_set]
<C>Keyboard settings will be updated.
<C>Are you sure?
[/KB_set]

// Default Keyboard
[KB_reset]
<C>Restore the keyboard to
<C>default settings?
[/KB_reset]

// Remove Keyboard
[KB_cancel]
<C>Keyboard settings have not been updated.
<C>Are you sure you want to remove settings?
[/KB_cancel]

// Update Pad
[PAD_set]
<C>Controller settings will be updated.
<C>Are you sure?
[/PAD_set]

// Default Pad
[PAD_reset]
<C>Restore the controller to
<C>default settings?
[/PAD_reset]

// Remove Pad
[PAD_cancel]
<C>Controller settings have not been updated.
<C>Are you sure you want to remove settings?
[/PAD_cancel]

entries.source:
\font[1]\f[18]Warning
\font[1]\f[18]Save data from "PlayStation 4" system
"PlayStation Vita" system can be shared.

To use this function, you must sign in with the
same Sony Entertainment Network account.

Only system data is saved, so
interim saves will not be saved.
Additionally, keep in mind that
when downloading system save data,
interim save data will no longer be useable.
entries.translation:
\font[1]\f[18]警告
\font[1]\f[18]“PlayStation 4”系统与
“PlayStation Vita”系统的存档可以共享。

使用此功能时，必须登录同一个
Sony Entertainment Network账户。

只会保存系统数据，因此
中途存档不会保存。
此外请注意，下载系统存档后，
中途存档将无法继续使用。
entries.previous_translation:
\font[1]\f[18]警告
\font[1]\f[18]从“ 播放器” 保存数据 4" 系统
“播放Vita”系统可以共享。

要使用此函数,请与
索尼娱乐网络账户。

仅保存系统数据, 所以
临时保存不会被保存 。
此外,铭记
当下载系统保存数据时,
临时保存数据将不再可用。

japanese_check.text:
\font[1]\f[18]ご注意
\font[1]\f[18]PlayStation\sysS[57]4、PlayStation\sysS[57]Vitaのセーブデータを
共有してゲームを進める事が出来ます。

利用の際には、同じ”PSN”のオンラインIDへの
サインインが必要となります。

保存されるのはシステムデータのみで、
中断データは保存されません。
また、システムセーブデータをダウンロードすると
中断データが使用できなくなりますのでご注意ください。

entries.source:
# Confirm Upload
[ConfirmUL]
<C>System save data will be uploaded to "PSN".
<C>Interim save data from an adventure cannot be uploaded.
<C>Would you like to start uploading?
[/ConfirmUL]

# Confirm Download
[ConfirmDL]
<C>System save data will be downloaded from "PSN".
<C>If you download data, interim data will no longer be useable.
<C>Would you like to start downloading?
[/ConfirmDL]

# Upload Successful
[SuccessUL]
<C>Upload to "PSN" complete.
[/SuccessUL]

# Download Successful
[SuccessDL]
<C>Download from "PSN" complete.
[/SuccessDL]

# Update Message
[AnnounceUpdate]
<C>\c[1]Updating system save data.
<C>Please do not turn off the power
or press the PS button.
[/AnnounceUpdate]

# Restart to Save Message
[AnnounceRestart]
<C>Returning to the Title Screen to
update data.
